Downtown Phoenix (85004) serves as Arizona's cultural, business, and entertainment epicenter. Home to Roosevelt Row arts district, world-class museums, professional sports venues, and the Phoenix Convention Center, this urban core has undergone a remarkable renaissance. Our executive transportation services connect business travelers, convention attendees, and culture seekers to downtown's diverse offerings.

Neighborhood guide

Downtown Phoenix has evolved from a traditional central business district into a vibrant urban neighborhood. Roosevelt Row (RoRo) anchors the arts scene with galleries, murals, boutiques, and First Friday celebrations. The museum district features the Phoenix Art Museum, Heard Museum, and Arizona Science Center. Heritage Square preserves Victorian architecture. CityScape and Arizona Center provide shopping and dining. The light rail connects to Tempe and Mesa, while new residential towers have brought thousands of residents downtown. Sports fans flock to Chase Field (Diamondbacks) and Footprint Center (Suns/Mercury).

Frequently asked questions

Do you provide convention center transportation in Downtown Phoenix?

Yes, we specialize in Phoenix Convention Center transportation. We offer group shuttles, executive car service, and airport transfers for convention attendees. Contact us for custom corporate transportation packages.

Can you take me to Diamondbacks or Suns games?

Absolutely! We provide game day transportation to Chase Field and Footprint Center. Skip the parking hassles and arrive in style. We'll drop you near the entrance and pick you up after the final whistle.

Do you offer First Friday Art Walk transportation?

First Friday is one of our busiest nights! We offer transportation to Roosevelt Row for art walk evenings. Our drivers know the best spots to explore and can help you navigate the galleries and murals.

How far is Downtown Phoenix from Sky Harbor Airport?

Downtown Phoenix (85004) is just 5 miles from Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport. Our airport transfer service takes 10-15 minutes, making it incredibly convenient for business travelers and convention attendees.
